༄༅/ /phung bshig 'khor lo nag po'i phrin las dug gsum me'i spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phung bshig 'khor lo nag po'i phrin las dug gsum me'i spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

phung bshig 'khor lo nag po sgrub pa'i phrin las dug gsum me'i spu gri zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud bzhi'i dpung bcas bsgral ba'i snying khrag la// ngom par rol pas myos pa rdo rje'i gar// sa gsum srid rtser g.yo ba rdo rje'i rgyal| |gshin rje'i gshed po de la snying nas 'dud// rang phyir tsam ma yin pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba la snying nas mos pa'i sngags pas/ 'khor lo nag po'i gdams pa nyams su blang ba'i tshe/ 'khor lo chen po las phran dang bcas pa gang dgos bca' gzhi gzhung ltar rdzogs par bya zhing*/ sman raka gtor mchod la sogs pa dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad 'du byas la/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bla ma mchog dang 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed// sangs rgyas chos tshogs dam can srung mar bcas// skyabs 'os skyabs kyi dam pa mchog rnams la// byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar// 'gro rnams bsgral zhing bstan pa bsrung slad du// phrin las drag pos log 'dren tshar gcod pa'i// sems bskyed dam pa deng nas bskyed par bgyi// lan gsum/ gtor ma cha gsum spyi 'gro ltar btang la/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dpal chen khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// khros pa'i sbyor bas kun kyang 'joms par byed| |gnod byed dam sri lan chags bdud dang bgegs// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod yon 'di khyer la// rang rang gnas sam gzhan du da dengs shig |gal te mi 'gro 'di ru 'tshe byed na// khro rgyal bdag gi thugs srog 'od zer las// khro bo khro mo khro chung skar ltar spros// mtshon cha mi bzad sna tshogs me rlung chu// sa dang ri rab la sogs thogs pa yis// khyod kyi mgo dang don snying tshal par 'joms// de bas rang srog bsrung la 'gro bar gyis| |oṃ ya mānta ka sarba bhū ta gatstsha/

zhes dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid zil gnon thugs srog las// 'od 'phros 'khor lo rdo rje dang*// rin chen padma rgya gram rlung*// me chu nam mkhar bcas pa yi// gur dang sa gzhi ra bar bcas// de dag so so'i khro bo dang*// khro mo sprul pa yang sprul gyis// log 'dren bsrung zhing mtshams gcod pa'i// las kyi dus gsum kun tu 'bad// e ma bdag gzhan lha dang bgegs// mnyam yangs zil gnon thugs kyi klong*// rol pa chen por 'byams klas pas// bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med// don dam mtshams 'di legs bcad kyi// bgegs las sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang*// de la gzhom gzhig byar med do// oṃ ya mānta ka tsakra bi du ra ratna padma bi shwa badzra bā yu agni dzwa la bhū mi ga ga na pra kā ra pañdzi ra bi tā na hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ mchod pa rnams/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid thugs srog hūm̐ 'bar ba'i// 'od kyis mchod pa sman rakta// gtor mar bcas pa'i dri ma sbyangs// bhandha 'bar ba'i snod rnams su// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag dbang po// sha tshil mkhris pa thod rkang ni// yon chab me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mor bcas// sman dang gtor ma'i 'og tu yaṃ// rlung dkyil de'i steng raṃ las me// kaṃ las thod sgyed gsum gsum steng*// a las thod pa dum bu gcig /phyi dkar nang dmar sha lnga dang*| |bdud rtsi lngas gang rlung me sbar// thod dros rdzas khol 'od rlangs kyis// sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis ni// byin brlabs ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /thim pas ye shes bdud rtsi ni| |stong gsum gang ba tsam du gyur// bhandha rlon pa zur bcas pa'i// nang du ra las rakta'i mtsho// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba lbu phreng g.yo// dba' rlabs 'khrugs pas gang bar gyur// ces bsam/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/

gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā ba lingta/ ma hā rakta pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa ni/ bdag nyid gnyen po stobs kyi lha bskyed pa dang*/ mdun du mngags pa las kyi lha bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rim pa bya ba ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos rnams ma skyes skye med stong pa'i ngang*// skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'byung ba'i rgyu la ni// e las 'byung ba nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// mthing nag gru gsum rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus// klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan// stobs chen phyogs skyong dregs pa bsnol ba'i steng*// ma he padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// ya las gshin rje tshe bdag nag po ni/ sku mdog mthing nag dug chen 'khyil ba 'dra// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bzhugs// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag po'i zhal// spyan dgu 'jigs pa'i sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs| |ral pa kham nag thor tshugs gyen du 'khyil// dbu la bde gshegs rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhugs// 'khor lo rdo rje ral gri g.yas na 'dzin// be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub g.yon gsum phyag /mi lpags glang chen ko rlon gos su gyon// stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs sku smad dkris// gdug pa'i sbrul gyis mgul dang lhu tshigs brgyan// dur khrod chas brgyad rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs// spyi bor srung mdzad rdo rje khyung chen ni// klu rnams dbang du sdud mdzad sku mdog dkar// phyag gnyis klu rgyal sbrul mgo zhal du gsol// klu rnams kun gyi gshed du gsal bar bskyed// mgrin par khro rgyal rta mchog rgyal po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar la 'tsher// g.yas na shes rab ral gri 'bar ba bsnams// g.yon na sdigs mdzub ye shes me dpung 'dzin// spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher// ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i nang na bzhugs// glang chen stag lpags rgyan gyis rab tu mdzes// srog bdag rgyal po la sogs dbang sdud bsgom// thugs kar gsang bdag rdo rje rgyal po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing nag 'bar// g.yas pa rdo rje rtse dgu nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dril bu dku la brten// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra drag po sgrog

/rgyan rnams ma lus sku la rab tu rdzogs// 'jig rten dregs pa pho mo'i srog snying rnams// ma lus 'phrog cing 'joms pa'i sku ru gsal// lte bar bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni// zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog ljang nag 'bar// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang rngam pa'i zhal// g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams// bar pas rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ste// g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung log rtog sreg /bar pa'i phyag na kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bsnams// tha ma gnyis kyis ri rab phur pa 'debs// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gshog pa rnam par brkyangs// spyan dgu 'jigs pa'i sdang mig me ltar 'bar// glang chen ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi dang*// stag lpags rlon pa thod phreng rnam par mdzes// lha srin gdug pa'i gnyen por bsgom par bya// thugs ka'i ya ma ga'u kha sbyor nang*// thugs srog hūm̐ las 'od 'phros tshur 'dus pas// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gnyis med gyur// spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ e/ 'og min chos dbyings mkha' khyab klong yangs nas// khro rgyal kun 'dus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// mkha' lding rta mchog phyag rdor kī la ya// 'khor bcas gdug pa 'dul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs// oṃ ya mānta ka ga ru ḍa ha ya grī ba badzra ku mā ra e hye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ e/ drag po e yi gzhal yas brjid pa'i dbus// klu gnyan sa bdag phyogs skyong bsnol ba'i khrir// padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// khro rgyal sku yi dkyil 'khor chen po ru// mkha' lding dbang chen srog bdag phur pa'i lha// dregs pa 'dul phyir mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs// oṃ ya mānta ka ga ru ḍa ha ya grī ba badzra ku mā ra tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ e/ rang rig rang gsal 'jam dpal khro bo'i rgyal// dregs pa 'dul mdzad gnas bzhi'i yi dam lha// rang rtsal rol pa'i khro rgyal tshogs rnams la// gnyis med brda yi mtshon nas phyag bgyi'o// oṃ ya mānta ka ga ru ḍa ha ya grī ba badzra ku mā ra tiṣṭha lhan/

ku mā ra na mo na maḥ mchod pa ni/ e/ ya mānta ka 'khor dang bcas pa la// mchod yon me tog bdug pa mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ ya mānta ka ga ru ḍa ha ya grī ba badzra ku mā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapad| rū pa/ shapad/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ pū dza pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ khyad par gyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i mchog /dug lnga gnas 'joms ye shes lnga yi dngos| |rigs lnga yum lnga'i rang bzhin ra sa yān// sbyangs spel sbar ba bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di// rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// lag na rdo rje 'chi bdag dregs pa'i gtso// zla ba bi tri shantiṃ garbaha dang*// padma 'byung gnas ri'u rdo rje dpal// mtshan ston yon tan rgya mtsho dpal sgron zhabs// rdo rje 'bar dang mar pa zhwa nag can/ */ shangs pa chag lo nyi ma seng ge dang*// skar pa gu ru pa nas rim brgyud de// rdo rje 'chang dbang nor bu rgyan pa'i bar// bka' brgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams dang*// ya mānta ka mkha' lding kā ru ṇa// rta mgrin dbang chen gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas pa la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes dbul/ hoḥ sman zhal bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho nas// mtha' ltag nyi zla 'bar ba yis// bdud rtsi'i bcud bsdus rang gis myang*// sku lnga ye shes lnga lhun grub// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta siddhi pha la hūm̐// zhes rang gi lcer myang*/ rakta brlab cing*/ hūm̐ */ khrag rgyun 'dzag pa'i bhandha ru// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i ru dhī ra// ya mānta ka 'khor bcas la// 'bul gyi bzhes la dngos grub stsol// oṃ ma hā rakta la kha raṃ khā hi/

sman raka gtor mar bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhandha 'bar ba ru// sna tshogs bcud ldan dam rdzas gtor ma che// 'dod yon longs spyod kun dang ldan pa 'di// ya mānta ka mkha' lding rta mgrin dbang*// phyag na rdo rje rdo rje gzhon nu sogs// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul gyi bzhes| *|oṃ ya mānta ka ga ru ḍa ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi badzra ku mā ra ma hā ba lingta kha kha khā hi/ zhes dbul/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ye shes 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas// bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// sku mdog mthing nag chen po la// dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad// g.yas zhal dung ltar dkar la mdzes// zhi ba'i las rnams ma lus 'grub// g.yon zhal dmar la rnam par mdzes// 'gro drug sems can ma lus pa// thugs rje'i chags pas skyong bar mdzad// dbus zhal mthing nag 'jigs pas ni// dregs pa ma lus dbang du sdud// zhal nas me 'bar 'jig rten khams// sreg cing dbang du sdud par mdzad// phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na// gsod byed 'khor lo 'bar ba bsnams// dregs pa'i mgo bo rnam par gshog /phyag drug g.yas kyi bar pa na// gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams// log rtog ma lus 'joms par mdzad// phyag drug g.yas kyi tha ma na// shes rab ral gri 'bar ba bsnams// gdug pa ma lus mgo lus 'byed// g.yon gyi dang po'i be con gyis// sde brgyad drag po dbang du sdud// bar par sdigs mdzub me dpung 'bar| |dgra bgegs ma lus sdig cing sreg /g.yon gyi tha mas gtun shing bsnams// lha srin sde brgyad don snying 'gas// zhabs bzhi yis ni bdud bzhi mnan// me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dregs byed bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs// ya mānta kar phyag 'tshal bstod// mgrin par rta mgrin dbang gi sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmar// dbang gi rta skad rnam par 'tsher// rgyal po srog bdag la sogs pa// 'jig rten lha srin dbang du sdud// phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri yis// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams gsod cing gtub// g.yon gyi ye shes me dpung gis// rnam rtog bag chags ma lus sreg

/sku la bskal pa'i me chen 'bar// zhe sdang gdug pa 'joms mdzad pa'i// rta mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ thugs kyi sprul pa gsang ba'i bdag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing*// g.yas pas rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams// g.yon pas dril bus chos sgra sgrog /stag sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan| |khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa// gtum chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni// sku mdog ljang nag 'od zer 'phro// zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste| |g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse dgu 'dzin// phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod cing*// bar pas rdo rje rtse lnga yis// dregs pa ma lus srog snying 'gas// g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung bsnams| |nyon mongs bag chags ma lus sreg /bar pas kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum bsnams// dug gsum rtsad gcod sku gsum ldan// tha gnyis ri rab phur bu sgril// dregs byed rlog cing gsod par byed// spyan dgu 'jigs pa'i sdang mig bsgrad// hūm̐ gi nga ro khams gsum sgrog /rdo rje'i gshog pas gdug pa 'dul// phrin las rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// rdo rje khyung chen klu 'dul ni// sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i tshul// klu gnyan ma lus zhal du gsol// ral gri'i gshog pas bar snang khengs// klu dang sa bdag dbang du sdud// dregs pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// ye shes khyung la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla med mchod pa rgya chen po// dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma 'di// ye shes lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes su gsol// ces bstod/ lus la srung ba dgod pa ni/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying ga nas// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang sna bug nang*// rna ba g.yas ma g.yon du ra// lag mthil g.yas tsa g.yon du kro// rkang mthil g.yas ta g.yon du hūm̐// thugs kar hūm̐ la rtsa ba'i sngags// yi ge bcu pas g.yas su bskor// zhes dmigs/

bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// steng 'og be con gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs stong ral gri'i dbyibs// gur khang bcas pa'i rang sgra ni// ha hā'i gad rgyangs rdo rje'i sgra// srung dus nang blta zlog dus phyir// blta zhing bsrung ba'i gur du gyur// ces dmigs pa'i ngang nas/ rtsa ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ hrīḥpadmānta kṛta badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi tsaṇḍa ma ha ro ṣa ṇa badzra kī li kī la ya badzra ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le rakṣa rakṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes so// snying po ni/ oṃ ya mānta ka ha ya grī ba badzra pā ṇi kī la ya ga ru ḍa rakṣa swā hā/ zhes so// nye ba'i srog snying ni/ oṃ ya mā ri hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ khroṃ ma ma rakṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes so/ khyad par can gyi srung sngags bcu pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐/ zhes pa rnams las sngags gong ma las 'og ma rnams je mang du bzla zhing gtso bo 'bru bcu pa la nan tan bskyed do// gnyis pa mdun gyi 'khor lo 'chi bdag bskyed pa ni/ e phe sha ka du bhrūṃ zhes pas/ e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// phe las dug sbrul sbal nag gtams pa'i gur// sha las dug sbrul sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i gur// ka las chu srin sngon po'i ka gdan byas| |du las nad kyi char pa rab tu 'bab// bhrūṃ las 'khor lo 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas khang*// srid pa'i rdo rje rgya gram gdan steng du// 'khor lo dug mtsho rab tu 'khyil ba'i nang*// dug sbrul sdig sbal gtams pa'i gzhal yas su// dug dang nad rlangs na bun 'khrigs pa'i nang*// lte ba mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus// oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya hūm̐ dzaḥ phe las 'chi bdag nag po ti pa tsa// zhal gsum phyag drug dug gsum dbu dang ldan// sku stod srin po sku smad sbrul du 'khyil// dbus ni chu srin g.yas pa sbrul nag 'jigs// g.yon pa 'dod chags bya yi mgo bo la// sbrul mgo gsum gsum dgu yi gdengs ka can// khram shing sbrul zhags mda' gzhu g.yas na 'dzin// g.yon gsum nad kyi rkyal pa 'dzin// 'jigs tshul dgra bo zhal du gsol// de yi lto bar dgra bo las ngan rnams// dug dang nad rlangs 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil du// rab tu rdung zhing nyams thag tshud par bsam// gtso bo'i phyi rim ling tshe brgyad kyi nang*// tri brgyad 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las// pe har shing bya zhon nas khram shing thogs// g.yon pa kun na phung bshig 'khor lo bskor// tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs bya rgod bcibs// phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas 'khor lo bskor// bdud nag sprel zhon nad rkyal 'khor lo bskor// klu bdud sbrul zhon sbal nag 'khor lo bskor// btsan bdud khyi zhon zhags nag 'khor lo bskor// bdud nag rta zhon thod phreng 'khor lo bskor// ag se bu mo bya zhon thags bzang thogs// ma bdud sdom zhon tho ba 'khor lo bskor// dam nyams dgra bo re re'i don snying za// srog gcod phung brlag sna tshogs byed par bsgom// de yi phyi rim ling tshe bcu drug la// tri nag 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las// tshangs pa gdong bzhi phyag shing 'khor lo bskor// yab rje nag po khram shing 'khor lo bskor// khyab 'jug nag po sbrul mjug mig gis gang*// zor ba g.yas la sbrul zhags g.yon na 'dzin// gnam khyi mi lus khyung gshog sta re 'dzin// g.yon pas sprul zhags nag po dgra la 'debs// gnyan rgyal ga ru khyung mgo lcags sdig 'dzin// srin rgyal lag ring ro za mche ba gtsigs// ma mo khrag 'thung thod khrag nad rkyal 'dzin// klu bdud sbrul mjug sbrul gyi dra ba 'dzin// yaksha me dbal glang mgo sta re 'dzin// hab sha bse gdong sbal mgo chu srin 'dzin// rdor legs tho ba ra yi rgyal mtshan 'dzin| |raksha za byed 'khar gsil lhung bzed thogs// yam shud dmar po sprel mgo phyag ma 'dzin// ser rkyang spyang mgo phur bu zhags pa thogs// gshin rje bya thul be con thod pa thogs| |thel mgo hab la sprel mgo bre srang 'dzin// nyams pa'i dgra la phung brlag byed par bsgom// de yi phyi rim ling tshe nyer gcig la// tri nag nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'phro 'du las// klu bdud mgo dgu sbrul zhags mda' gzhu 'dzin// smad ni sbrul gyi chun por 'khyil ba'o// chu srin mgo can lcags sdig nag po 'dzin// sa bdag sdig mgo sbrul zhags nad rkyal 'dzin// bud med sbrul mjug khram shing nad rkyal 'dzin// stag mgo sbrul zhags tsakra lag na 'dzin// mgo dgu sbrul mjug zhags pa nad rkyal 'dzin// glang mgo sbrul mjug chun po sdig pa 'dzin// sbrul mgo sbrul mjug zhags pa sta re 'dzin// sha mgo sbrul mjug zhags pa nad rkyal 'dzin// spyang mgo sprul mjug chu srin zhags pa 'dzin// khra mgo sbrul mjug ral gri phung g.yab 'dzin// ra mgo sbrul mjug rlung g.yab nad rkyal 'dzin// glang chen mgo can rus sbal khrag zor 'dzin// sbrul mgo sbrul mjug lcags kyu nad rkyal 'dzin// rta mgo sbrul mjug sog le tho lum 'dzin// chu srin sbrul mjug ral gri sbrul zhags 'dzin// seng mgo sbrul mjug sbrul zhags nad rkyal 'dzin// khyi mgo sbrul mjug mtshon dug sbrul zhags 'dzin| |phag mgo sbrul mjug ri rab sbrul zhags 'dzin// dred mgo sbrul mjug dra ba sbrul zhags 'dzin// 'ug mgo sbrul mjug thod pa sbrul zhags 'dzin// dur spyang mgo can khrag rkyal sprul zhags 'dzin// kun kyang sku stod mi la sku smad sbrul// dgra bo'i bla srog 'gugs shing sgrol// nang khrol don snying rngams shing za bar bskyed// lha klu dregs pa gdug pa ma lus pa// sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun dang bcas// sprul pa yang sprul pho nya bran 'khor g.yog

/ro la 'bu yis za zhing g.yo ba ltar// dam nyams dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bsam// bdag nyid thugs las lcags kyu lta bu'i 'od// phyogs bcur spros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i// dregs pa ma lus bkug nas 'khor lo yi// rang rang gzugs la bstims pas gnyis med gyur// spyan drang ba ni/ e/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' rab yangs mtha' dbus bral// 'byams klas gzhal du med pa'i zhing khams nas// 'chi bdag dug gsum gdug pa dregs pa'i 'khor| |dpung bcas gnas 'dir myur du sa mā dzaḥ e phe laṃ du bha tri yaṃ nā ga phu dza dzaḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes brjod pas dregs pa rnams byon nas rang gzugs la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni| e/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang*// rang rang rigs mthun brjid rngam rol pa las// so so'i gdan la dregs pa gtso 'khor bcas// dgra bgegs tshar chod bar du tiṣṭha lhan// dam la bzhag pa ni/ 'chi bdag 'khor bcas kyi mgor be con bzhag /lce la bdud rtsi byin la/ e/ nga ni 'jam dpal khro bo che// rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs byed pa// lag na rdo rje be con 'chang*| |nga yi bka' sgrubs dam ma 'gal// sngon tshe gshin rje gshed po yi// spyan sngar dam bcas dran par gyis// gal te dam las khyod 'da' na// be con 'khor los mgo snying 'gas/ rnam shes rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung*// de bas dam las ma 'da' bar// bcol ba'i las ni myur sgrubs shig /badzra sa ma ya hoḥ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dgra bgegs dam nyams bsad cing bsgral ba ni// snying khrag dmar gyi arghaṃ rba rlabs 'phyo// chu ser zhag dang bcas pa'i zhabs bsil bskyil// mig dang rna ba sna lce me tog bkram// sha chen rkang klad gsur gyi bdug pa dkrigs// ro ras tshil chen gyis sbar snang gsal brjid// mkhris chen chang sbyar dri chab mi sdug 'jigs// sha rus pags pa'i zhal zas dang re spro// thod rnga rkang gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog

/sna tshogs gzugs kyi rnam rol gar bsgyur zhing*// snyan dang mi snyan rol mo'i nga ro 'dzin// ngad ldan dri yi phreng ba sprin ltar gtibs// ro bcud brgyad ldan bza' btung skar ltar bkram// gos rgyan rang rang chas brjid 'dod dgur bcas// chos dbyings mnyam yangs gdal ba klong du chub// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin tshogs// nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang yongs bkang nas// 'chi bdag nag po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad| gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe/ dharma dhā tu pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes thun mong gi mchod pa dang*/ khyad par dam rdzas btung bar bya ba ni/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum kun gyi bdud rtsi dang*// rgya mtshor gnas pa'i bcud la sogs// mtshan ldan bhandha 'dir gtams pa'i// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar la bkug pa// 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pas bzhes// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen 'di| |srid gsum bsgral ba'i rakta dang*// phyi nang 'byung ba'i ru dhi ra// bsdus te 'chi bdag 'khor bcas kyi// btung bar 'bul te ngom par rol// dam rdzas bcud ldan gtor ma la// khams gsum longs spyod bza' bca'i phud// ma tshang med par byin brlabs pa// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas zas su 'bul// dgyes tshim rang sar bzhugs su gsol// drag po'i phrin las dus la bab// oṃ ma ra ṇa pa ti e tri ma phu sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā rakta/ ma hā ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtor mar sman raka sgron gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags mthar/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhna bhakṣa ku ru hoḥ zhes dbul/ bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang*// gsol lo mchod do 'chi bdag tshogs// dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi// sha chen ri ltar spungs pa 'dis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// rakta mtsho ltar 'khyil ba 'dis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// rus pa gram bu ltar bkram pa// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// snying mchin glo 'tsher mkhal mar bcas// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// mig rna sna lce dbang po'i tshogs| |'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// rgyu long pho mkhris lgang par bcas// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// drod gsher la sogs khams lnga yis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// klad rkang gzhung pa khams chu ser// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// skra sen pags dri ljan ljin gyis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dgra bo'i pha ma phu nu yis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// chung ma bu tsha bu mo yis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// gnyen bshes mdza' grogs 'khor g.yog gis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// yul mkhar zhing gzhis rta phyugs kyis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// bdun rgyud rtsa bar bcas pa yis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam gnyan po des skong la// bskangs gyur drag po'i las mdzod cig

/bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ 'chi bdag 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// khyod ni zag bcas mngon shes spyan mnga' bas// dus gsum legs nyes ma sgrib sa ler mkhyen// bdag ni gti mug dbang gyur 'khrul ba yis// ma mthong ma thos ma shes ma rtogs dang*// log min mthong thos shes rtogs ngan lhad kyis// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dang 'gal ba rnams// gnong 'gyod sems kyis da lta bshags bgyid na| |tshangs shing bzod pa dam pa bzhes nas kyang*// sgrib med 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// mthol yang mi bzod bshags kyang mi tshangs na// dam can khyod kyi sgrib par 'gyur du mchi| |de bas mthol bshags bzod tshangs la gnas mdzod// ces dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ */ dug can lto 'gros gtams pa'i gzhal yas na// dug mtshon rims kyis gang ba'i gur khang na// srid pa'i rgya gram 'khor lo 'bar ba'i dbus// dug mtsho 'khyil dbus sbrul dang sdig sbal khrir// las kyi 'chi bdag nag po ti pa tsa// dbus zhal gti mug chu srin rngam bzhin bsgrad// g.yas zhal zhe sdang dug sbrul phu sgra 'byin// g.yon zhal 'dod chags dur byas rkan sgra rdeb// sbrul gdengs dgu ni srid rtser 'phyo zhing g.yo// sku stod srin po mi bzad khros pa'i tshul// phyag drug g.yas kyi dang pos khram shing bsnams// skye 'gro ma lus dus mtha'i khram la 'debs// bar pas dug sbrul zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching*| |tha mas dug gi mda' gzhu dgra snying gzir// g.yon gsum nad kyi rkyal pa 'phyar zhing rdeb// stong gsum dgra la dal yams bskal par 'bebs// dgra bgegs srog rtsa snying bcas zhal du 'dren// sku las dug dang thog ser mtshon cha me// mdze phol shu 'bras khrag nad rgyu gzer dang*// lhog rgod mi rungs ltas ngan char ltar 'bebs// sbas pa'i yum chen klu mo lus grib ltar// mi mngon 'khril sbyor 'dod bde'i me dpung 'bar// 'chi bdag nag po khyod la bdag bstod do// las kyi ti pa tsa la bdag bstod do// mthu chen klu bdud gtso la bdag bstod do// phyi rim bka' sdod las kyi dmag dpon brgyad// pe har bya zhon tshangs pa dung thod can// bdud nag spu gri klu bdud dug sbrul zhon// btsan bdud khyi zhon bdud nag rta nag zhon| |ag se bya zhon ma bdud shing sdong zhon// las kyi bdag po brgyad la bdag bstod do// de rgyab pho nya dregs pa'i dmag dpon ni// tshangs pa gdong bzhi yab rje nag po dang*// khyab 'jug chen po gnam khyi nag po dang*// gnyan rgyal ga ru ma mo khrag 'thung ma// yaksha me dbal hab sha bse gdong dang*// rdo rje legs pa raksha za byed dang*// yam shud dmar po ser rkyang chen po dang*// gshin rje bya thul thel mgo hab lar bcas// ci bgyi'i bka' nyan bcu drug bdag gis bstod// de'i phyir dregs pa'i dmag dpon chen po ni// klu bdud dang ni chu srin gdong can dang*| |sa bdag sdig mgo bud med sbrul mjug can// stag mgo mgo dgu glang mgo sbrul mgo can// sha mgo spyang mgo khra mgo ra yi mgo// glang chen mgo dang sbrul mgo rta mgo can// chu srin sbrul mjug seng mgo khyi yi mgo// phag mgo dred mgo 'ug gdong dur spyang mgo// kun kyang mi sdug ro stod mi yi lus// ro smad ro nye dgra bo'i bla srog 'gugs// gzas pa'i nang khrol don snying rngams zas byed// dregs byed dmag dpon rnams la bdag bstod do// bka' 'khor dmag tshogs lha klu gza' skar bcas// rgyal bsen gza' btsan bdud klu sa bdag sman// 'gong po the'u srog bdag gnod sbyin gnyan// srin po 'byung po yi dwags sha za dang*// smyo byed rjed byed mkha' 'gro ma mo gdon// de sogs srid gsum la gnas dbang byed pa'i// dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud klu rgyud kyis// bsdus pa'i dmag tshogs kun la bdag bstod do// phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor mar bcas// so sor rang nyid gang 'dod rdzas yo byad// mkho dgu 'bul gyi dgyes dgu'i myur bzhes la// sngags 'chang bdag gi 'dod 'bras las kyi gnyer// ma thogs myur du bzhes shig sa ma ya hoḥ

/zhes bstod/ sngags bzla ba ni/ 'bod pa/ rbad pa/ bsad pa/ khram la gdab pa/ grong khyer bsgyur ba dang lnga las/ 'bod pa ni/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing ga dang*/ mdun bskyed dang 'chi bdag gtso bo'i thugs kar phe nag po/ 'khor gyi dregs pa thams cad kyi snying khar tri rang rang gi mdog can rnams las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pa'i 'chi bdag dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa skad cig la nam mkha' nas kha ba bab pa lta bu/ bar snang la rdul 'khrigs pa lta bu/ sa 'og nas rlangs pa 'phyur ba ltar bkug nas 'khor lo'i rang gzugs so so la rdo tshan la kha ba bab pa dang*/ chu dang chu blugs pa ltar sib sib tha mi dad du thim pas/ dmigs bya dgra bgegs de nyid rtsad nas chod kyi bar du 'khor lo'i gzugs dang tha mi dad par gnas nas rang rang gi srog snying ngag tu bzla zhing*/ bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs med du sgrub pa gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐/ e phe sha ka du bhrūṃ/ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ nā ga kro dhī shwa rī/ nā ga du na nā ga du na/ he li he li/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes 'bod pa'i sngags 'di nyid nyin mtshan thun bcad smra ba bskyungs la bzla/ thun drug la 'chi bdag 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul zhing bskul bya/ thun gtor dgra bo'i sha khrag tu bsams la 'khor lo'i mdun du 'bul/ dpang gzu bden brdar kho'i nyes pa bsgrags nas/ 'gugs 'dren drag po nyer gcig las mi nyung ba'i mthar/ kiṃ kang gi bla 'gugs dang lha dbye'ang bya/ rang dang 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu spros/ gzas pa po'i snying nang gi nṛ yig bla srog dang bcas pa rang dbang med par bkug /'khor lo'i liṅga rnams la sib sib thim pas liṅga rnams dgra bo dngos su yod par bsam/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ nā ga kro dhī shwa rī'i mthar/ dgra bo che ge mo nṛ tri ā karṣa ya aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes bla 'gugs sngags thun re la stong phrag gsum re dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ nā ga kro dhī shwa rī dgra bo che ge mo'i lha srung a nṛ traka raksha mā ra ya phye ma ma traka ru tra mā ra ya rbad/ ces lha dang dbye ba'i sngags kyang stong tsho re las mi nyung ba bzla zhing*/ bla 'gugs pa'i tshe/ rang dang 'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs srog las 'od zer rlung dmar lta bu drag cing gdug pa spros pas/ gzas pa po'i skyob pa'i lha lnga dang*/ dbang thang gi lha sum cu/ srung byed kyi lha thams cad sbur ma rlung gis gtor ba'am/ bya rog rdos brdas pa'am/ sran phung la ber ga rgyab pa ltar thor thor 'thor zhing bskrad nas phyis dgra de la mi 'khor bar bsams la bzla/ 'bod pa'i ring dregs pa 'du ba'i ltas dang bla khug cing lha dang bral ba'i mtshan ma nges par 'byung ba gal che'o// 'bod rtags rdzogs nas bsad pa'i las ni/ rang gi thugs srog las 'od 'phros pa 'chi bdag gtso bo'i thugs srog la phog rgyud bskul/ 'chi bdag gi thugs srog las 'od 'phros pa 'khor gyi dregs pa thams cad kyi snying kha'i srog la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyis stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre thams cad rang dbang med par bskul nas/ lha 'dre'i dmag gis nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad gang ba go cha sra zhing mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams skar mda' btang ba lta bu/ bar snang la rgyu ba sprin dang na bun rgyug pa lta bu/ sa gzhi la rgyu ba rnams sho rbud 'ong ba thon pa ltar skad cig la phyin nas/ dgra yul dregs pa'i dmag gis khengs/ than dang ltas ngan nad mtshon ser/ dme 'khrug la sogs char ltar phob/ dgra bo'i snying gi nang du dregs pa'i pho brang btab/ dgra 'khor dang bcas pa dbang du bsdus sh-ing thal ba'i rdul du brlags/

lhag ma gtan nas ma lus par byas par bsams la/ gong gi 'bod sngags kyi hūm̐ dzaḥ'i mthar| hūm̐ nā ga raksha ru tra kā lā bhyo/ dgra bo'i snying la baṃ ril tsitta la rgyob/ traka thur snying thur/ snying 'gul 'gul/ myag myag rtsa bzhi bskum/ shan shan srog la shan/ thur thur dgra bo'i tsitta la rbad bhyo/ sa nā ga la tsa ma ri/ dgra bo'i snying la thun bhyo/ nā ga rā dza ti pa tsa ya dgra bo'i dbugs la bhyo/ mdze gri nag po thuṃ ya rbad bhyo/ zhes rbad sngags btags pa bzla/ thun drug la thun gtor dregs pa'i dmag tshogs su bsams nas dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ gzhan 'gugs dbye la sogs pa thams cad 'bod pa'i skabs ltar bya'o// de ltar rbad pa grub pa'i rtags brtan po mthong nas/ bsad pa'i las la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis 'chi bdag bskul ba sogs gong gi 'bod pa'i skabs ltar la/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa rnams kyis dgra bo rang dbang med par bkug nas/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsgral zhing bsad bcad gtub/ tshe bdag 'khor bcas kyis hab dir dir lhag ma med par sha zos/ khrag 'thung*/ rus pa mur/ klad pa don snying rnam lnga rngams zas su rol/ pags pa gyon nas rjes shul tsam yang ma lus par byas par bsams la/ gong gi rbad sngags kyi thun bhyo'i mthar/ e nag po ti pa tsa ya| nā ga raksha/ dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya dzaḥ klu sbrul nag po nā ga snying la ya/ sa nā ga phu ye phu ye phu ye dzaḥ dgra bo 'di rnams kyi sha khrag la mā ra ya rbad rbad dzaḥ zhes btags pa 'bod rbad bsad gsum gcig tu dril la bzla/ thun drug tu liṅga la thun brab/ thun gtor liṅga la rdeg go// thun brab pa'i tshe gong gi bsad sngags kyi mjug tu/ hūm̐ phe sha ka du nag po ti pa tsa ya nā ga kro dhī shwa rī ya ma ra du phaṭa dgra bo shig du la| nan nan/ nā ga rā tsa shi la du shi dgra bo yaṃ yaṃ/ dung shing phung ya/ brlag brlag

/du shi ya ma dgra bo'i srog phung shig mā ra ya/ du ya dgra bo snying du sod/ ya ma raksha 'dus ya/ dgra bo mā ra ya/ sarba du na ya ha la mā ra ya sha trūṃ sod/ 'chi bdag ya ma raksha khyod la dgra bo gtad do// dgra bo'i kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i rgyun chod cig /ces thun sngags dang*/ de la lha 'dre kun gyi drag sngags 'di btags so// e rā tsa rgyal po sa ma ya/ tri du dza/ tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ ma ma tri tri yaṃ yaṃ dzaḥ phu phu nā ga tri dzaḥ bhandha bhandha/ rā tsa tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ dkar po tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ nag po tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ gnam tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ sa tri ma yaṃ dzaḥ rā tsa tsitta 'dus 'dus ma yaṃ dzaḥ dgra bo'i tsitta la 'dus 'dus/ ku ku reng reng*/ be ra be ra/ rā tsa he he dzaḥ nā ga phu phu tri dzaḥ nā ga du she du she/ thib thib/ 'dus 'dus/ zhes pho brang btab pa'i sngags dang*/ rā tsa siddhi sa ma ya thib dzaḥ rā tsa a ho sa ma ya shig /rā tsa sā manta stis sta st+waṃ/ rā tsa tri tri dzaḥlhan/ ro'u ro'u/ tri tri dza dzaḥ thib thib dzaḥ tri dzaḥtri dzaḥ rā tsa tri hoḥ rā tsa tri tri dza dzaḥ rgyug rgyug /thib thib/ gnam brag ya/ a kro te ya shan/ tri thun tri thun/ dza dzaḥyaṃ yaṃ/ shig shig /ro'u ro'u| yaṃ yaṃ/ du she nā ga dzaḥ tri tri dza dzaḥ lhan lhan/ thib thib/ dza dzaḥ tri ma tri du tri dzaḥ rā tsa dzaḥ thib thib/ du du/ she she/ tri tri/ yaṃ yaṃ/ nā ga du she/ nā ga du she/ ā karṣa ya/ ā karṣa ya/ dgra bo rnams phung phung shig shig /sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ de wa thib/ rā tri chum thun/ nṛ mā ra ya chum thun/ bā su dha ri ṇe/ sa ma ya chum chum/ bhandha bhandha/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad nan/ de'i phyi la drag sngags btags/ nṛ dza phe phu/ tsi te tsi te phu/ tsi ta e ka phu/ nā ga phe sha phu/ shang ka ru ti phu/ hu lu hu lu/ urgha te phu/ he ga sha ra ya phu// nā ga nā ga rā dza phu/ dza dza dzaḥ sha sha sha/ shū shū shū/ ma ma/ mi mi/ sa ka tsi ti hu ya hu li dgra bo thun sod zung*/

nā ga ro la thib/ he he he/ la bying ging*/ kī li mi li mā ra ya/ raṃ raṃ tsa ma ri phyung*/ nā ga phu mā ra ya/ oṃ phe laṃ mā ra ya hūm̐/ nā ga raksha he khu laṃ/ ha la ha la/ nag po tsa ma ri/ nā ga raksha phe laṃ hūm̐/ dgra bo srog dril hur thuṃ rbad| haṃ shaṃ tri sa ma ya bhyo mā ra ya phaṭa/ tri kha thun tri kha thun/ bhyo thig hab/ ha ra ha ra/ ti ma ma ti/ hab hab/ nā ga yaksha kro dha ni/ dgra bo mā ra ya rbad/ thun bhyo sod/ 'di la khram sngags nyer lnga btags par bya'o// de la drag sngags bdun gyi sham bu 'di gdags so// e phe sha ka du bhrūṃ/ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ nā ga kro dhī shwa rī/ sa ma ya daṃ/ tri ya ma du ra tsa sha/ nā ga du na ya/ dgra bo'i gnas su chug cig /mi nor 'khor bcas phung phung brlag par gyis shig /mā ra ya sod ya rbad/ ces thun sngags btags la brab bo// de ltar bsad pas bsad rtags brtan po lan gsum yan chad nges par mthong nas/ khram la gdab pa'i las bya ba ni/ dug gi khrag sngags kyis ngar btags pa'i liṅga rnams la khram ris btab cing*/ hūm̐ phe sha ka du nā ga rā dza tri ling shang ka du ni ya ma badzra sā du ni dung dung*/ du ni du ni/ dung shing khram khram/ zhes pa nas/ sha ra du na khram khram ces pa'i bar khram sngags nyer lnga po zur du bkol yod pa ltar khram la btab pa'i las bya/ de nas grong khyer bsgyur ba ni/ gong gi 'bod rbad bsad pa'i sngags dril ba'i mthar/ trig nan hur thuṃ dza mā ra ya rbad| dam dam sa ma ya/ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ laṃ nan rbad rbad bhyo/ zhes grong khyer bsgyur ba'i sngags btags pa bzla zhing gong ltar thun brab dang khram gdab sogs rbod gtong gi las thams cad phu phrugs su drag tu bya/ de ltar sgrub pa'i ring rang nyid kyis 'bod rbad bsad sogs gong du bshad pa'i sngags rnams go rim ma 'chol bar rtags dang sbyar la rim gyis bzla/ sgrub grogs kyis 'khor lo chen po dang nam mkha' sa gzhi rgya mtsho gsum la gtad pa dang*/

dug gsum 'khor lo mgyogs byed spun gsum/ dregs pa nyer gnyis/ 'chi bdag khog gtad/ tsha tsha smyon pa/ mdze rkang ma/ rang thag ma/ mi lnga ma/ dpung 'phul rnams kyi sngags rnams lhan cig tu bris pa'i sngags byang chen mo zur bkol du yod pa ltar drag tu bzla/ de ltar sgrub pa'i ring thun drug tu 'gugs dbye gtor bsngos sogs kyi mthar bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dug gsum ro langs 'khrugs pa'i dbus// bskal pa brgyad khri gtams pa'i gzhal yas na// klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi dbus// phyogs skyong dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan// ma he glang rgod nyi zla padma'i gdan// shin tu mi bzad gtum chen khros pa'i sku// rab 'jigs 'jam dpal nag po gshin rje'i gshed// sku mdog mthing nag nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// gar gyi nyams dgu brjid pa'i dpal dang ldan// zhal gsum phyag drug pha rol phyin drug phyag /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing drag po'i zhal// g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje dang*// g.yon gsum be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub zhags// dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyis rab tu brjid| |sku gsum yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ de yi thugs sprul 'chi bdag nag po ni// bskal pa sbrul nag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// dug gsum rgyal po 'chi bdag mgo dgu pa// bdud gcig bdud sde 'chi bdag klu yi bdud// dgra bo'i bdud la khyod las lhag pa med// dug gsum dbu gsum rgyu drug phyag /sbrul zhags nad rkyal srid gsum 'dul| |mjug ma rgya mtsho'i gting du brkyangs// 'khor du klu srin pho nyar 'gyed// sku ni nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam// lha rnams yongs kyi kha lo bsgyur// spyan ni bar snang yongs la gzigs| |gza' rnams ma lus pho nyar 'gyed// sku ni ri rab ngos la brten// lha srin sde brgyad las la 'gyed// phyag gi sprul pas stong gsum khyab// sa bdag gnyan gsum pho nyar 'gyed| |sbrul nag 'bar ba'i ral pa la// gdug pa'i dug nad tsha tsha 'phro// ā ra li yi sgra sgrog pas// khams gsum ma lus mdze shus 'gengs// spyan nas khrag gi bu yug 'bebs// shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma 'tshub// zhal nas nad kyi char pa 'bebs// dug gsum khros pa 'chi bdag srog gi bdag

/brgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la// gnag pa'i dgra bo myur du sgrol| |hūm̐ */ de dang gnyis med 'khril ba'i yum chen ni// bud med sbrul gyi mjug ma can// rgyu ni bar snang khams su rgyu// dgra bo'i bla 'gugs las byed ma// klu srin sa bdag pho nyar 'gyed| |sbrul zhags thun khrag nad yams 'bebs// phung byed 'chi bdag yab yum dang*// bka' 'khor las byed thams cad la// sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*// dgra bo dam nyams zhal du stobs// 'chi bdag 'khor bcas dgra la bhyo// pho la bab na srog rtsa chod// mo la bab na mngal nas skoms// chung la bab na rtsad nas chod// 'khor la bab na 'khrug tu chug /nor la bab na rlung la bskur// khyim la bab na phung la shig /yul la bab na gtan nas rlogs// zas nor phung shig brlag tu chug /phung nye sna tshogs dgra la phob| |'jam dpal bka' las ma 'da' bar// sa ma ya yis rang don srungs// bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// mdun du 'dod chags zhe sdang dang*// gti mug nyon mongs 'khrugs pa'i dbus// phung byed rlung gi gzhal yas khang*// bskal pa'i rlung nag 'ja' 'od 'khyil// char sprin klog 'khyug thog 'brug sgrog /rgya mtsho'i dug rlangs 'khrugs pa'i dbus// nyi zla'i 'od zer skar phran rgyu// stong gsum 'khrugs pa'i bha ga las// dug gsum dbang phyug 'chi bdag nag po ni// dbu gsum rgyu drug 'joms pa'i phyag rgya che// gza' bdud sprul pa dbu yi gtsug nas 'gyed// 'chi bdag srog bdag brgyad ni thugs las sprul// klu bdud brgyad ni mjug ma sprul du 'khyil// rgyu drug nad kyi bdag mo phyag na bsnams// 'khor du phung byed dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor// rang 'dra gdug pa'i mtshon cha phyag na thogs// sprul pa yang sprul dran pa tsam gyis ni// 'chi bdag rgyal po'i bka' yi las rnams byed// bstan dgra lha phral 'khor bcas zhal du bstab// phung byed las kyi rim pa gnyer du gtad// bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// 'chi bdag klu bdud 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dam nyams dgra bo 'di yi tsitta la khā hi/

maṃ sa la khā hi/ rakta la khā hi/ srog la khā hi/ dbugs la khā hi/ go ro tsa na la khā hi/ ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba lingta la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas drag tu bskul zhing dmod pa dang dpang gzu bden brdar nyes bsgrags sogs bya/ 'bod pa'i ring thun gtor dang zan ling re bsgral ba lhan cig 'khor lo'i mdun nam/ 'chi bdag gi gtor ma la bstab/ rbad pa'i dus zan ling bsgral nas gtor ma la stob cing thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo/ bsad pa'i dus zan ling bsgral la bstab/ thun gtor khram ling la brdeg /'khor lo rnams la mi brdeg /khram btab dang grong bsgyur gyi dus ni/ thun gtor dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo// sgrub pa thon nas 'khor lo rnams kyi liṅga sogs liṅga thams cad la bla gnas sar phur bu btab/ thun brab/ mi gsad pa'i mtshon chas rdeg cing bsad sngags bzla/ khram sngags bzla zhing khram la btab/ sngags zhabs rnams su dgra bo che ge mo mā ra ya rbad sod btags la rbod gtong gi las drag tu byas rjes 'khor lo rnams lhan cig tu sbom par 'os pa rnams steng 'og phyi nang ma log par brtsegs shing bltab pa dang*/ 'khor lo so sor las sbyor byed dgos rnams kyang so sor byed chas dang ldan pas snod so sor gzhug cing*/ so sor mnan gtad bya tshul sogs 'khor nag gi gzhung rnams su gsungs pa la/ gya tshom dang 'ol tshod/ ham stobs/ yin rlom/ zab zob byas na rang nyid phung nges pa'i rgyu yin pas blo brtan cing yid gzhung pa/ rig pa rno zhing lag len bde ba/ gzhan pa'i kha 'gengs dang rgyas 'gebs sogs bsres lhad med par gtsang sing nge ba byas te las la sbyar na bstan dgra phung zhing rang nyid bde bar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi gsungs pa nyid mi bslu nges pa'i tshad ma yin te/ ji skad du/ nam mkha' med par gyur na yang*// sngags kyi dngos grub med mi srid// lha dang drang srong gis bshad pa'i// rig sngags bslu ba mi srid na// 'dod chags bral bas gsungs pa yi// gsang sngags sbyor bas bslu ba ni// ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// las sbyor zin nas gtor ma rnams dgra phyogs su 'phang*/

las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas pa'i shul du rdo rje rnam 'joms la sogs pa'i gzungs chus chag chag gdab/ rang nyid bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang gtad zlog dang tshe sgrub la 'bad/ 'khor nag sgrub pa'i ring nyin mo sgrub khang du sngags bzla ba sogs bya/ nub mo mal sa gzhan du spo bar yang gsungs so// de ltar bshad pa rnams ni 'khor nag sgrub pa'i las byang dang sngags bsgrigs sogs dkyus su bkod pa yin gyi/ 'khor lo rnams 'bri ba nas bzung ste las la sbyor ba'i bar ni 'khor lo nag po'i gzhung nyid nas bshad pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// smras pa/ gang zhig rab 'bar rdo rje'i mtshon rnon gyis// bstan dgra phung ba'i phrin las rmad po che// rtogs pas 'jam dpal khro bo'i thugs rje yis// bdag blo smin pas slar yang der 'dud do// de ltar rdzas sngags ting 'dzin phyag rgya yi// sbyor bas zhing bcu bsgral ba'i thabs chen po// ngan sngags rgyal pos 'di 'dra rtogs pa na// bon dang mu stegs gdug pa'i ngan sbyor dang*// byis blo'i gdams phran ngan sems gnag pa yi// ban sngags phal gyi gnas la re thang chad// la las mngon spyod las kyis bsgral ba dang*// dug mtshon sbyor bas bsad la khyad par ci// zhes pa'i bsting tshig smra zhing rgol ba'i dus// dug mtshon sbyor ba rin gyis nyos rnams bsad// thub bstan bgres po dbu 'phang mtho ba dang*// 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams ci dgar chos spyod ba'i// so khang bsrung la drag sngags gces so zhes// rdo rje can gyi rgyud rnams thams cad du// lan gcig min par gsungs pas ci phyir bslu// gdug la byams ldan rtsa ltung bcu pa dang*// gzhan yang ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud chen du// bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste// de sogs byed pa tshar bcad nas// 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsungs| |zhes sogs dngos bstan rgyud las gsungs pa'i phyir// sngags pa ngas kyang lam 'di 'bad pas bsgrub// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can skal dman pas// bla ma rnams kyang smin grol rgyang bsrings nas// mo bon gto chog las la 'bad pas sgrub| |mkhas pa rnams kyang tshad ma rnam bzhi yi// legs bshad dor nas rang rgyab lung gis skyor// dge slong rnams kyang 'dul khrims rgyang bsrings nas// chos brgyad dmar ser chos la 'phyor chas byed// sngags pa rnams kyang rim gnyis yal dor nas// grong 'dre'i khol po 'gong po'i gsol dpon byed// rtogs ldan rnams kyang sgom sgrub rgyab bskyur nas// rmi ltas mngon shes zol gyis dad ldan bslu// bla ma slob dpon thugs dang 'gal ba'i las// ji snyed byas nas rang nyid bden par sgrub// che che 'jigs 'jigs 'dra bas 'gyings pa ni// da lta bde zhing gzhan kun mos mos 'dra// bslu med las dang rdo rje 'chang dbang pos// bshad pa'i dam tshig gnad rnams bden srid na// de dang de 'dra phyi ma cir 'gyur ba// bsams nas blo chung bdag sogs snying rlung ldang*// de lta'i tshul gyis sa steng gang ba yi// dus ngan 'di 'drar skyes pa 'u cag kyang*// bskal pa dman zhing bsags pa tha shal na'ang*// 'jam mgon dpal bo'i thugs rje'i 'od phreng gis// snying nas drangs pas rgyud don gnad rnams kun// sa 'og gter bzhin ma sbas lag son pas// bsags rab gyur snyam dga' bde'i nyams brgya bsgyur// 'di yis dkar po'i phyogs rnams dbu mtho zhing*// nag phyogs bdud kyi rtsa lag rab bcom nas// bstan pa rab rgyas de 'dzin bde zhing 'tsho| |'dus pa rgya mtsho'i chos spyod bar chad med// sems can kun kyang bde bar spyad pa yi// dge ba gang des 'gro kun rdzogs ldan ltar// dga' bde'i dpal ldan chos bzhin rab spyad nas// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang dam pa der// rdo rje snyems mar dga' bder rab sbyor ba'i// zung 'jug bde ba mchog dang mi 'bral shog

/de ltar phung bshig 'khor lo nag po bka' ma sgrub pa'i phrin las dug gsum me'i spu gri zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ bdag mdun gyi mngon rtogs dang bdag bskyed kyi bstod pa bskul sogs 'khor nag gi yig cha rnying pa sor bzhag dang*/ gzhan rnams skabs su gang bab kha bskangs nas dbur stod 'bri lung chos phyug tu skyu ra'i gdung las son pa/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong grub dbang padmas dbur smyon zhes ming du btags pa dus mtha'i sngags pa nag po thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya bas/ me mo gnyis skyes kyi lo ri dwags kyi lang tsho dang ldan pa'i gzhon nu dbo yi dga' ma dang rtse dgas rol pa'i dus kyi cha dkar po'i rgyal ba dang por/ klung shod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'di ni thub bstan yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bdud tshogs mi mthun pa'i chom po las bsrung ba'i lcags rir smon lam btab nas bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
